title: Are you looking for something in particular?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Are you looking for something in particular?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, I'm looking for a jacket.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: This one's really popular. It comes in different sizes and colours.
lines.ko: 이거 진짜 인기 많아요. 사이즈랑 색상도 여러 가지로 나와요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Can I try it on?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Of course. The fitting room's just over there.

title: Bang for the buck

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How much is this?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It's $79, but it's on sale today.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How much is it now?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It's $49. Bang for the buck.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'll take it.

title: How are you finding it so far?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How are you finding it so far?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah... it's not bad.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Gotcha. Is it more the fit, or just not quite your style?
lines.ko: 그렇구나. 핏이 좀 그런 거예요, 아니면 그냥 스타일이 딱 맞진 않는 거예요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I think it's the fit. It feels a bit snug.
lines.ko: 핏인 것 같아요. 좀 꽉 끼는 느낌이에요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That makes sense. You might feel more comfortable in the next size up. I'll bring it over
lines.ko: 그럴 수 있죠. 한 사이즈 큰 게 더 편하실 수도 있어요. 제가 가져다 드릴게요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, maybe

title: Hi there. Are you looking for anything specific today?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hi there. Are you looking for anything specific today?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 오늘 특별히 찾으시는 거 있으세요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, I'm looking for a laptop.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sure. What will you mainly use it for?
lines.ko: 네. 주로 어떤 용도로 쓰실 거예요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Mostly work and some light video editing.
lines.ko: 주로 일하고, 가벼운 영상 편집 정도요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: In that case, I'd recommend this Macbook. It's lightweight, fast, and great for multitasking.
lines.ko: 그럼 이 맥북 추천드려요. 가볍고 빠르고 멀티태스킹에 딱이에요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: How much is it?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It's 1,399. It also comes with a 2-year warranty. Is there anything you're unsure about?
lines.ko: 1,399달러예요. 2년 보증도 포함돼 있어요. 혹시 고민되는 부분 있으세요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Well, I'm torn between Macbook Air and Macbook Pro.
lines.ko: 음, 맥북 에어랑 맥북 프로 사이에서 고민 중이에요.

title: I can walk you through the options

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How much does it cost?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Pricing depends on what you need. I can walk you through the options if that helps.
lines.ko: 가격은 필요하신 거에 따라 달라요. 괜찮으시면 옵션들 하나씩 설명해 드릴게요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Okay, sure.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: To make sure I'm on the same page, how are you planning to use it?
lines.ko: 제가 제대로 이해했는지 확인하려고 그러는데, 어떻게 쓰실 계획이세요?

title: Feel free to keep that hot one if you'd like!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I really don't wanna bother you, but I ordered an iced latte and this is hot.
lines.ko: 진짜 귀찮게 하고 싶진 않은데, 아이스 라떼 시켰는데 이거 뜨거운 거예요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Oh no, it's no trouble at all! I'm really sorry about that. Thanks for letting me know.
lines.ko: 아이고, 전혀 귀찮지 않아요! 정말 죄송해요. 말씀해 주셔서 감사해요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'll remake it as an iced latte right away.
lines.ko: 바로 아이스 라떼로 다시 만들어 드릴게요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thanks Sam.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Feel free to keep that hot one if you'd like! It's on the house.
lines.ko: 뜨거운 건 원하시면 그냥 드세요! 서비스예요.

title: We've been waiting for over 40 minutes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: We've been waiting for over 40 minutes.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I completely understand your frustration. I'm really sorry about the wait.
lines.ko: 답답하신 거 충분히 이해해요. 오래 기다리게 해서 정말 죄송합니다.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: No one told us it would take this long.
lines.ko: 이렇게 오래 걸린다고 아무도 말 안 해줬잖아요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: We're a bit short-staffed today, but that's no excuse.
lines.ko: 오늘 일손이 좀 부족하긴 한데, 그게 핑계가 될 순 없죠.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: So how much longer will it be?

title: Excuse me, I think there's something wrong with my sandwich.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Excuse me, I think there's something wrong with my sandwich.
lines.ko: 저기요, 제 샌드위치에 뭔가 문제가 있는 것 같아요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm sorry about that. May I ask what the issue is?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I just noticed there's some mold on the bread. Is it possible to get a refund?
lines.ko: 방금 봤는데 빵에 곰팡이가 있어요. 환불 받을 수 있을까요?

title: Excuse me, I'd like to talk to someone in charge.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Excuse me, I'd like to talk to someone in charge.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Of course. How can I help you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: One of the staff members made a comment that made me uncomfortable.
lines.ko: 직원 한 분이 한 말 때문에 좀 불편했어요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm really sorry to hear that. Would you mind telling me what was said?
lines.ko: 그런 일이 있었다니 정말 죄송해요. 어떤 말이었는지 말씀해 주실 수 있을까요?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: They made a comment about my background, and it felt inappropriate.
lines.ko: 제 출신에 대해 얘기했는데, 부적절하다고 느꼈어요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Thank you for telling me. That is unacceptable, and I sincerely apologize.
lines.ko: 말씀해 주셔서 감사해요. 그건 절대 있어선 안 되는 일이고, 진심으로 사과드립니다.

title: Isn't this place a vibe?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Isn't this place a vibe?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah it is we've been here so long that was great
lines.ko: 응 맞아, 우리 여기 엄청 오래 있었네, 좋았어.

lines.speaker: C
lines.en: Thank you guys. Thank you so much. No worries.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: (They) don't mind if you just hang around and have a chat They really just don't mind like how long you stay
lines.ko: (여기 사람들은) 그냥 앉아서 수다 떨어도 신경 안 써. 얼마나 오래 있든 진짜 상관 안 해.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Are they..? Do you think they..

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: No they don't mind

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: They don't mind having you stay. You can just hang around
lines.ko: 우리 있어도 괜찮대. 그냥 편하게 있어도 돼.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Do you think they..

lines.speaker: C
lines.en: Can I get you guys anything else? So, anything else you guys would like to... We're just close...
lines.ko: 더 필요한 거 있으세요? 그러니까, 더 주문하실 거... 저희 곧 마감이라...

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can we get another coffee?
lines.ko: 커피 한 잔 더 주실 수 있어요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I was... I was.. that...

lines.speaker: C
lines.en: Hang on sorry. What was it? sorry.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can I get a Large almond. Oh wait, no I'll get a large soy... or should I get a small soy
lines.ko: 라지 아몬드로 주세요. 아 잠깐, 아니 라지 소이로 할게요... 아니면 스몰 소이로 할까?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Get a.. get a soy..get a half soy and half skim
lines.ko: 그냥.. 소이로.. 반은 소이, 반은 저지방으로 해.

lines.speaker: C
lines.en: You know what? we'll just do takeaway. We'll probably do that as takeaway sorry.
lines.ko: 그럼 이렇게 해요, 그냥 테이크아웃으로 할게요. 아마 테이크아웃으로 드려야 할 것 같아요, 죄송해요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sorry. sorry while you ordering, could I just grab another one of those... um what was... the little pastry..
lines.ko: 죄송한데, 주문하시는 김에 저것도 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요... 음 그게 뭐였더라... 그 작은 페이스트리..

lines.speaker: C
lines.en: Let just back and grab your order.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: it's like a little pastry... I think, I don't know what it's called? What are your pastries options?
lines.ko: 작은 페이스트리 같은 건데... 이름을 모르겠네요? 페이스트리 뭐 뭐 있어요?

lines.speaker: C
lines.en: Umm we've got the large a Twix donut. So, I can get you one of those.
lines.ko: 음, 큰 트윅스 도넛 있어요. 그거 하나 드릴 수 있어요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes. Did you have the..

lines.speaker: C
lines.en: I think the chef's just left. Actually it is 10:20
lines.ko: 셰프가 방금 퇴근한 것 같아요. 사실 지금 10시 20분이라서요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Are you guys closing soon?

lines.speaker: C
lines.en: Technically, we closed an hour ago.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Just get the donut man.

lines.speaker: C
lines.en: Let me just grab.. Come on you bastard
lines.ko: 잠깐만 꺼낼게요.. 아 좀 나와라 이 녀석아.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yeah these guys are great. because I just stay as long as i need.
lines.ko: 응, 여기 사람들 진짜 좋아. 내가 원하는 만큼 그냥 있어도 되거든.

title: Hey, do you have a second?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hey, do you have a second?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, what's up?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: When you have a moment, could you take a look at this?
lines.ko: 시간 날 때 이것 좀 봐줄 수 있어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, I have a lot on my plate today, but I'll check that out later.
lines.ko: 그럼, 오늘 할 일이 좀 많긴 한데 이따 확인해 볼게.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: No rush at all, whenever you're free is fine.
lines.ko: 전혀 급한 거 아니야, 편할 때 아무 때나 괜찮아.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Cool just give me one sec.

title: It depends. If you're taking me to lunch

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hey, can you cover the meeting for me tomorrow? Just this once.
lines.ko: 야, 내일 회의 나 대신 들어가 줄 수 있어? 이번 한 번만.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Well, it depends. If you're taking me to lunch.
lines.ko: 음, 상황 봐서. 점심 사주면 생각해 볼게.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Come on, you owe me. I couldn't even take my day off last time. I was up almost all night because of you.
lines.ko: 에이, 너 나한테 빚 있잖아. 지난번에 나 쉬는 날도 못 쉬었어. 너 때문에 거의 밤샜다고.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I know, I know. Let me check my schedule and get back to you.
lines.ko: 알아, 알아. 스케줄 확인해 보고 다시 말해줄게.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: You're a legend. Lunch is on me!

title: Any chance you could help me wrap this up today?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hey, any chance you could help me wrap this up today?
lines.ko: 저기, 혹시 오늘 이거 마무리하는 것 좀 도와줄 수 있어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'd love to, but I'm a bit swamped right now.
lines.ko: 도와주고 싶은데, 지금 일이 좀 밀려 있어서.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It won't be long.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I get that, but I don't want to overpromise and let you down.
lines.ko: 그건 아는데, 괜히 된다고 했다가 실망시키고 싶지 않아서.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Okay, that's fair.

title: Hey Bethany, would it be okay if I took next Friday off?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hey Bethany, would it be okay if I took next Friday off?
lines.ko: 베서니, 다음 주 금요일에 쉬어도 괜찮을까요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Next Friday? We actually have a big catering order for a party. It's going to be a bit hectic with all the prep.
lines.ko: 다음 주 금요일? 사실 그날 파티 케이터링 큰 주문이 있어. 준비할 게 많아서 좀 정신없을 거야.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Oh, I see. I wasn't aware of the catering job.
lines.ko: 아, 그렇군요. 케이터링 일 있는 줄 몰랐어요.

title: If Margot is cool with handling the catering prep, then that's no problem

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: But I've already asked Margot, and she said she can cover my shift.
lines.ko: 근데 마고한테 이미 물어봤는데, 제 시프트 대신 해줄 수 있대요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: If Margot is cool with handling the catering prep, then that's no problem.
lines.ko: 마고가 케이터링 준비 맡는 거 괜찮다고 하면 문제없어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Perfect, thanks! I'll double-check everything with her and update the roster.
lines.ko: 좋아요, 감사해요! 마고랑 다 한 번 더 확인하고 로스터 업데이트할게요.

title: First things first!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Oi! You must be the new one. Got your white card?
lines.ko: 어이! 네가 새로 온 친구구나. 화이트 카드 있지?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Uh...yeah. Here you go.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Good. First things first — PPE on at all times. Hard hat, hi-vis, steel caps. Yeah?
lines.ko: 좋아. 제일 중요한 거부터 — 보호장비는 항상 착용해. 안전모, 형광 조끼, 안전화. 알았지?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Got it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Watch your step around the scaffolding. It's a bit dodgy over there. Don't be a hero.
lines.ko: 비계 근처에선 발 조심해. 저쪽 좀 위험해. 괜히 무리하지 마.

title: Smoko time. Drop everything.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Smoko time. Drop everything.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Finally.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: After this we gotta knock out the brickwork by arvo. The chippie reckons it'll take longer though.
lines.ko: 이거 끝나면 오후까지 벽돌 작업 끝내야 돼. 근데 목수는 더 걸릴 거래.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: How strict is Dave about the deadline?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Deadset strict. If we fall behind, he loses it.
lines.ko: 진짜 엄격해. 일정 밀리면 완전 폭발해.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Right. No mucking around after smoko then.
lines.ko: 알겠어요. 그럼 쉬는 시간 끝나고는 딴짓 금지네요.

title: We're out of screws

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Oi, who's doing the Bunnings run? We're out of screws.
lines.ko: 어이, 버닝스 누가 갔다 올래? 나사 다 떨어졌어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Where's the gopher?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Gone walkabout again.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Deadset bludger. Jisoo — you right to go?
lines.ko: 진짜 게으름뱅이네. 지수 — 네가 갔다 올 수 있어?

lines.speaker: C
lines.en: Yeah, no worries. What do we need?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Box of 75mm screws. Cheers.

lines.speaker: C
lines.en: Noted.

title: You should've asked before you started

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Jisoo! What happened here? This is a bloody dog's breakfast.
lines.ko: 지수! 여기 무슨 일이야? 완전 엉망진창이잖아.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: My bad. I'll fix it right away.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: You should've asked before you started.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: You're right. Won't happen again.
lines.ko: 맞아요. 다시는 이런 일 없을 거예요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: No dramas. Just ask next time.

title: They don't know what they're doing

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Why do they keep hiring backpackers. They don't know what they're doing.
lines.ko: 왜 자꾸 워홀러들을 뽑는 거야. 뭘 하는지도 모르잖아.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I heard that, Tom. I'm still learning, but I work hard. Give me a chance.
lines.ko: 다 들었어요, 톰. 아직 배우는 중이지만 열심히 해요. 기회 좀 주세요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Fair enough.

lines.speaker: C
lines.en: Good on ya for standing up. He's all bark, no bite.
lines.ko: 할 말 한 거 잘했어. 저 사람 말만 세지 별거 없어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: She'll be right, yeah?

lines.speaker: C
lines.en: Ha! now you're talking.

title: Grab a snag off the barbie!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Jisoo, grab a snag off the barbie.
lines.ko: 지수, 바비큐에서 소시지 하나 집어 가.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Already on it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Fair dinkum, this weather's unreal. Stoked it's not raining. Perfect arvo for it.
lines.ko: 진짜 날씨 끝내준다. 비 안 와서 완전 신나. 이런 거 하기 딱 좋은 오후야.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Your backyard is massive.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Cheers! Grab a coldie from the esky.
lines.ko: 고마워! 아이스박스에서 시원한 맥주 하나 꺼내.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Esky?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: The cooler box. It's full.

title: Keen on footy?
notes: *Collingwood (Magpies): 호주에서 가장 팬이 많은 footy 팀

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: This flat white is spot on.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, they know what they're doing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Keen on footy?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, heaps. I watch it every weekend.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Nice. Which team do you go for?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: The Magpies.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Fair dinkum? Same here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No way!

title: Grabbed something from Maccas on the way

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How's it going, mate?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah good, you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Bit dusty. Didn't sleep well.
lines.ko: 좀 피곤해. 잠을 잘 못 잤어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Skip brekkie again?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Nah, grabbed something from Maccas on the way.
lines.ko: 아니, 오는 길에 맥도날드에서 뭐 하나 사 먹었어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Barbie at mine this arvo, yeah? Emma's coming.
lines.ko: 오늘 오후에 우리 집에서 바비큐 하자, 알았지? 엠마도 와.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Ripper. I'll bring tinnies.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Cheers, legend.

title: Grab us a goon bag if you're at the bottle shop

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Jason! Grab us a goon bag if you're at the bottle shop.
lines.ko: 제이슨! 보틀샵 가면 군 백 하나만 사다 줘.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Goon? You sure? That stuff's rough.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Ha! Look at you, already a local.
lines.ko: 하! 너 좀 봐, 벌써 현지인 다 됐네.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I learned the hard way. Week one.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Crikey, first week on goon. You're basically Aussie now.
lines.ko: 세상에, 첫 주부터 군이라니. 너 이제 거의 호주 사람이다.

title: Hey, excuse me.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hey, excuse me.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: What the fuck, huh? Smoko's already over? what?
lines.ko: 뭐야 씨, 응? 벌써 쉬는 시간 끝났어? 뭐?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I just want some directions. Can you help me?
lines.ko: 그냥 길 좀 물어보려고요. 도와주실 수 있어요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Fuckin' chockers right now, mate. But where do you need to go, love?
lines.ko: 지금 존나 바쁜데. 그래도 어디 가야 되는데, 아가씨?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you know where the train station is?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Fuck me mate, haven't been on the train for 20 years ka. Taking train? Go down... um... There's a roundabout just down there. Just fuckin' chuck a left there. There's a Chook shop just up the road. Just chuck a right on that one and then, uh... There's a servo on the left. Shortcut through the servo just up there, mate. Yeah, fuckin' fair dinkum ka.
lines.ko: 와 씨, 나 기차 안 탄 지 20년은 됐는데. 기차 타려고? 쭉 내려가서... 음... 저 아래 로터리 있어. 거기서 그냥 왼쪽으로 꺾어. 길 따라 좀 올라가면 치킨집 있거든. 거기서 오른쪽으로 꺾고, 어... 왼쪽에 주유소 있어. 저 위 주유소 가로질러서 지름길로 가. 응, 진짜라니까.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Uh, okay. How long does that take?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Oh yeah, just be another 48 months or so. But umm..just waiting for that union strike to finish, then, uh... Once they pay up, get more of that shit we deserve, aye. That fuckin' dosh. It'll just be another 48 months after that one.
lines.ko: 아 그거, 한 48개월 정도 더 걸릴 거야. 근데 음.. 노조 파업 끝나길 기다리는 중이라, 그러고 나서, 어... 돈 주면, 우리가 받을 만큼 더 받아내고, 그치. 그 망할 돈. 그다음에 또 48개월 걸리겠지.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I mean how long does it take to go to the train station?
lines.ko: 제 말은 기차역까지 가는 데 얼마나 걸리냐고요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Oh, not too long, love, but um... Got important work to do here. Council needs me to do the job. Roads aren't gonna fix itself, mate.
lines.ko: 아, 얼마 안 걸려, 아가씨. 근데 음... 나 여기서 중요한 일 해야 돼. 시청에서 이 일 하라고 했거든. 도로가 알아서 고쳐지진 않잖아.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Okay.

title: I'll let you know if we're running low on anything

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hey, it's getting busy. Can you clear the patio tables and then check the oat milk stock?
lines.ko: 저기, 점점 바빠지네. 야외 테이블 좀 치우고 오트밀크 재고 확인해 줄래?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm on it. I'll clear the tables first.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Also, we need more sugar sticks at the condiment bar.
lines.ko: 그리고 소스 바에 설탕 스틱 더 채워야 돼.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Understood. I'll refill those right after I check the milk.
lines.ko: 알겠어요. 우유 확인하고 바로 채워 놓을게요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Perfect, thanks.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'll let you know if we're running low on anything.
lines.ko: 뭐 떨어져 가는 거 있으면 말씀드릴게요.

title: The latte was supposed to be iced

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: She says the latte was supposed to be iced. Did you take this order?
lines.ko: 손님이 라떼 아이스로 시켰다는데. 네가 이 주문 받았어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I reckon there's been a misunderstanding. I didn't take the order.
lines.ko: 뭔가 오해가 있는 것 같아요. 그 주문 제가 안 받았어요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Oh, who was on the till then?
lines.ko: 아, 그럼 그때 계산대에 누가 있었어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I guess Chloe was on the till. I've been on the machine the whole time.
lines.ko: 아마 클로이가 계산대에 있었을 거예요. 저는 계속 커피 머신 쪽에 있었어요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I see. The docket says "hot" though.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: You gotta be kidding me... I'm getting told off for this? I didn't even take the order.
lines.ko: 말도 안 돼... 이걸로 제가 혼나는 거예요? 주문도 제가 안 받았는데.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Looks like there's a typo on the docket. I'll remake it as an iced latte.
lines.ko: 주문서에 오타가 있었나 보네. 아이스 라떼로 다시 만들게.

title: Jot that down

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can you help me with the deep cleaning in the back?
lines.ko: 뒤쪽 대청소 좀 도와줄 수 있어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure. What should I do first? Start with the floors or the fridge?
lines.ko: 그럼요. 뭐부터 할까요? 바닥부터 할까요, 냉장고부터 할까요?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Let's do the fridge first. It takes longer.
lines.ko: 냉장고부터 하자. 그게 더 오래 걸려.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: When does this need to be done by?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It has to be done before 9.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: One more thing, who should I contact about the cleaning supplies? We're almost out of sanitizer.
lines.ko: 하나 더요, 청소용품은 누구한테 연락하면 돼요? 소독제가 거의 다 떨어졌어요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can you jot that down for me?

title: Hey Emma, just now a customer asked for three hundred...

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hey Emma, just now a customer asked for three hundred cash out. I didn't know what it was so I just said we couldn't do it.
lines.ko: 엠마, 방금 손님이 캐시아웃 300달러 해달라고 했는데. 그게 뭔지 몰라서 그냥 안 된다고 했어요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Wait, three hundred?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yeah. He said it was standard.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Good thing you didn't.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Why? Is cash out not a thing?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Cash out's a thing mate. But fifty, maybe a hundred max. Three hundred is a massive red flag.
lines.ko: 캐시아웃은 있지. 근데 50달러, 많아야 100달러까지야. 300달러는 완전 수상한 거야.

title: Just to confirm,

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: You're on painting today. Start with the top floor.
lines.ko: 너 오늘 페인트칠 담당이야. 맨 위층부터 시작해.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Copy that. Just to confirm, interior only, or are we hitting the exterior too?
lines.ko: 알겠습니다. 확인차 여쭤보는데, 실내만 해요, 아니면 외벽도 해요?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Interior only for now.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Any specific color order, or should I just work my way through?
lines.ko: 색깔 순서 정해진 거 있어요, 아니면 그냥 알아서 차례대로 할까요?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Start with white. Everything else is clearly tagged.
lines.ko: 흰색부터 해. 나머지는 다 표시돼 있어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That's what I'm talking about. Now we're talking.
lines.ko: 바로 그거죠. 이제 좀 말이 통하네요.

title: Did you guys go out without me?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Did you guys go out without me?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Oh, I didn't think you'd be interested, so I didn't ask.
lines.ko: 아, 너는 관심 없을 줄 알고 안 물어봤어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I mean... that kind of hurts, not gonna lie.
lines.ko: 아니 뭐... 솔직히 좀 서운하긴 하다.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I didn't mean it like that.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I know you didn't. But it would've been nice to be asked, even if I said no.
lines.ko: 알아. 근데 내가 안 간다고 했더라도 물어봐 줬으면 좋았을 것 같아.

title: Did you see the team meeting today? Dave presented the...

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Did you see the team meeting today? Dave presented the whole plan the one I put together.
lines.ko: 오늘 팀 미팅 봤어? 데이브가 내가 짠 계획을 통째로 발표하더라.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, I noticed. Did he mention you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Once. At the end. Kind of in passing.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That's not great.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm not angry. I just feel a bit... overlooked.
lines.ko: 화난 건 아니야. 그냥 좀... 무시당한 기분이야.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That's fair. You should say something to him.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I know. I just needed to say it out loud first.
lines.ko: 알아. 그냥 일단 입 밖으로 한번 말해보고 싶었어.

title: Tom looks down on me

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: He's just a backpacker. What would he know.
lines.ko: 걔 그냥 워홀러잖아. 걔가 뭘 알겠어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I feel like Tom looks down on me.

lines.speaker: C
lines.en: Yeah. He does that to everyone new. Don't take it personally.
lines.ko: 응. 걔 새로 온 사람한테 다 그래. 너무 신경 쓰지 마.

title: Are you being sarcastic just now?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Wow. Beautiful work, mate.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Oh, thanks! I tried to—

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm joking. It's completely crooked.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: ...Wait. Are you being sarcastic just now?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yeah, mate. The whole thing needs to be redone.
lines.ko: 어, 친구. 전부 다시 해야 돼.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Okay. I genuinely could not tell.

title: I turned down other plans because of this

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hey, you said you'd cover my shift Saturday.
lines.ko: 야, 토요일에 내 시프트 대신 해준다며.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Oh... yeah, I actually can't anymore.
lines.ko: 아... 맞다, 근데 이제 못 하게 됐어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Wait — you're telling me this now? It's Thursday.
lines.ko: 잠깐, 그걸 지금 말한다고? 오늘 목요일이야.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Something came up, mate. Sorry.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: You gotta be kidding me. I turned down other plans because of this. You can't just do that.
lines.ko: 장난하냐. 나 이것 때문에 다른 약속도 거절했어. 이러면 안 되지.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I said I'm sorry—

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sorry doesn't fix my Saturday.

title: What brought you here?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: So, what did you study back home?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I majored in business administration.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Cool! What kind of jobs did you do before coming here?
lines.ko: 오 좋네! 여기 오기 전엔 무슨 일 했어?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I worked at a marketing company for about two years.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Nice. So what brought you here?
lines.ko: 좋네. 그럼 여긴 어떻게 오게 된 거야?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I wanted a change. I was a bit burnt out, honestly.
lines.ko: 변화가 필요했어. 솔직히 좀 번아웃 왔었거든.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Fair enough. Best decision you made?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Getting on that plane. Hundred percent.
lines.ko: 그 비행기 탄 거. 백 퍼센트.

title: Coming here solo takes guts

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: You seem pretty settled in now. You planning to stay long?
lines.ko: 이제 꽤 자리 잡은 것 같네. 오래 있을 계획이야?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Not sure yet. Maybe a year? I'd love to travel around before I go back.
lines.ko: 아직 모르겠어. 한 1년? 돌아가기 전에 여기저기 여행 다니고 싶어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What you hoping to get out of it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Just... proper life experience, I guess. And honestly, confidence. And maybe save some money and improve my English too.
lines.ko: 그냥... 제대로 된 인생 경험? 그리고 솔직히 자신감. 돈도 좀 모으고 영어도 늘리고.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yeah, coming here solo takes guts.
lines.ko: 그치, 혼자 여기 오는 거 용기 필요하지.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I was nervous at first, but I'm glad I made it here.
lines.ko: 처음엔 긴장했는데, 여기 오길 잘한 것 같아.

title: I'm on the fence

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Are you planning to go back to marketing?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm on the fence I'm kind of thinking about doing something more hands-on.
lines.ko: 아직 고민 중이야. 좀 더 몸으로 하는 일을 해볼까 생각 중이야.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Like what?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I don't know yet. That's kind of the whole point of coming here...to figure it out.
lines.ko: 아직 몰라. 그걸 알아내려고 여기 온 거기도 하고.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That makes a lot of sense.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah. Back home, everyone's got a plan. Here, it's okay to not know.
lines.ko: 응. 한국에선 다들 계획이 있잖아. 여기선 몰라도 괜찮아.

title: What do you do for fun?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: So what do you do for fun?
lines.ko: 그래서 쉴 때 뭐 하고 놀아?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm really into hiking. Got into it properly since coming here.
lines.ko: 하이킹에 완전 빠졌어. 여기 와서 제대로 시작했어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yeah? Where've you been?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Blue Mountains last weekend. Honestly blew my mind.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That place is unreal. You should do the Grampians next.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Already on my list.

title: Apparently, Korean food is super spicy

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you cook much?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, I love cooking Korean food. It's kind of my thing.
lines.ko: 응, 한식 해 먹는 거 좋아해. 약간 내 특기야.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Like what?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Mainly stews, fried rice, stuff like that. Simple, but it's good though. I'll make you something. It might be spicy.
lines.ko: 주로 찌개, 볶음밥 같은 거. 간단한데 맛있어. 내가 하나 해줄게. 좀 매울 수도 있어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Apparently, Korean food is super spicy. But bummer — I can't handle spicy food.
lines.ko: 한국 음식 엄청 맵다며. 근데 아쉽게도 나 매운 거 못 먹어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Don't worry about it. I'll go easy on you.

title: Maybe we could grab dinner

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you have any plans for this weekend?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Not really. Why?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I was thinking... maybe we could grab dinner. Just the two of us.
lines.ko: 생각해봤는데... 저녁이나 같이 먹을까 해서. 우리 둘이서만.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Wait... are you asking me out?
lines.ko: 잠깐... 지금 나한테 데이트 신청하는 거야?

title: That was so awesome. I love spending time with you. You...

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That was so awesome. I love spending time with you. You wanna get something to eat?
lines.ko: 진짜 재밌었다. 너랑 있는 거 너무 좋아. 뭐 좀 먹으러 갈래?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Uh, can we actually talk?
lines.ko: 어, 우리 얘기 좀 할 수 있을까?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Oh, y..you wanna talk about...

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Us.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Us?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, I just wanna talk about where we are.
lines.ko: 응, 우리 지금 무슨 사이인지 얘기하고 싶어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Um, yeah, so what did you wanna talk about?
lines.ko: 음, 그래, 그래서 무슨 얘기 하고 싶은데?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I think I'm catching feelings. Are you seeing other people?
lines.ko: 나 너한테 마음이 생기는 것 같아. 너 다른 사람도 만나?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Am I seeing other people right now?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, 'cause I'm only seeing you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm seeing you. You're, like, my favorite.
lines.ko: 나 너 만나고 있잖아. 넌 뭐랄까, 내 최애야.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Your favorite?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yeah, like I told you, you're special.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I feel like you're just saying that.

title: I've never spent this much time with someone.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I've never spent this much time with someone.
lines.ko: 나 누구랑 이렇게 오래 시간 보낸 적 처음이야.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, but I, like, really like you.
lines.ko: 응, 근데 나는 너 진짜 좋아해.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: You know, I like what we have right now. Don't you think? Like, I get to spend time with you, we get to do cute things. And, you know, like, I'm just so busy with work and things like that. I just don't know if I have time for a relationship. And, you know, I just wouldn't feel right if I couldn't put all my energy and time into you. That wouldn't be fair to you. I just love what we have right now. Don't you think it's good?
lines.ko: 있잖아, 난 지금 우리 관계가 좋아. 안 그래? 너랑 시간도 보내고, 귀여운 것도 같이 하고. 근데 나 일 같은 거 때문에 너무 바빠서. 연애할 시간이 있을지 모르겠어. 그리고 너한테 내 에너지랑 시간을 다 쏟지 못하면 마음이 편치 않을 것 같아. 그건 너한테 불공평하잖아. 난 그냥 지금 우리가 좋아. 좋지 않아?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I don't know if I can keep doing this.
